title: Finite-level quotient transport
statement: For every f, F, y and n, the formal module quotient by the extended maximal ideal power is isomorphic to the pushforward of the finite-fibre pullback, compatibly with formalFunctionsFiniteFMap.

proof.text: Follow the finite-level pullback square and apply the closed-immersion unit quotient theorem, transporting along the canonical pullback and adjunction identifications.

mathlib_searches.query: formal finite fibre closed immersion quotient sheaf

lean.statement:
theorem formalFunctionsFinite_sheaf_quotient_iso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (F : X.Modules) (y : Y) (n : ℕ) :
    let F' := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F
    let J := (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      ((maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)).map
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).inv.hom)).comap
          (pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)
    ∃ e : formalModuleQuotient J (n + 1) F' ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (formalFunctionsFiniteι f y n)).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (formalFibreι f y n)).obj F),
      formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) F' ≫ e.hom =
        formalFunctionsFiniteFMap f y F n
